output.summary: The customer reports account takeover: email changed without authorization, $7,925.50 transferred to an unknown account. The customer is now locked out with no timeline for access restoration or refund.
issues: No timeline for access or reimbursement

financial_impact.evidence: $7,925.50 had been transferred out to an account I've never heard of

harm_ongoing.evidence: Now I'm locked out and nobody can tell me when I'll get access back or when I'll get my money back.

escalation_threat.evidence: If I don't hear back this week I'm moving my accounts to the credit union down the street.
